data.test_policy: sealed until frozen pointer and v2 checker final validation gates pass

checkpoint_selection: maximin class accuracy then balanced accuracy then lower BCE on selection documents; threshold picked on disjoint calibration documents

sealed_test_evaluation.original_answerable_questions: all 240 original sealed questions; report combined exact match, coverage, false-answer rate
sealed_test_evaluation.derived_missing_fact: two missing-field questions per sealed document, using the frozen generator; report abstention accuracy
sealed_test_evaluation.derived_corrections: one correction for each sealed source question; report current-value exact match and false-answer rate

safety: unchanged scratch/run.py preflight and parent live guard; no pointer optimizer
